page: Google Cloud Platform c4a-highmem-72 is an arm64-based virtual machine configured with 72 dedicated vCPUs and 576 GB of system memory. Operating on a 64-bit ARM architecture, this instance provides a high-density memory profile delivering 8 GB of RAM per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is not present, as the instance includes zero GPUs and relies completely on the host CPU cores for compute execution.

Storage architecture on the c4a-highmem-72 contains no bundled local disks, requiring persistent block storage attachments over the network for OS and application state. Additionally, complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not included with the instance. The dedicated core allocation avoids virtualization contention, offering predictable single-core and multi-threaded processing across all 72 ARM execution cores.

The 1:8 vCPU-to-memory ratio provides resource efficiency for workloads that require large RAM footprints without paying for excess compute capacity. The reliance on external block storage shifts I/O throughput to the network storage tier, which is an important operational consideration. This configuration is suited for large in-memory databases, distributed caching nodes, memory-heavy enterprise software, and large-scale ETL processing built for ARM.
description: Google Cloud Platform c4a-highmem-72 is a high-memory arm64 compute instance designed for memory-intensive workloads. It features 72 dedicated vCPUs and 576 GB of system RAM, maintaining an 8 GB per vCPU ratio. Built on an ARM architecture without hardware GPU acceleration, the instance provides isolated processing across all cores without thread competition. Local storage is not included, requiring external block storage for persistent operational and OS disks. In addition, no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are provisioned by default. The high memory density relative to core count makes the c4a-highmem-72 cost-efficient for large memory footprints, reducing the need to overprovision compute cores merely to acquire sufficient RAM. It is suited for in-memory database deployments, large distributed caching systems, in-memory data analytics, ETL processing pipelines, and memory-bound enterprise applications compiled for 64-bit ARM environments.
